units: SI; BeamNG vehicle axes +X left, +Y rearward, +Z up

rear_final_drive.contract: Front torque is taken from the rear final-drive assembly's geared output. Never attach it to either rear halfshaft or silently replace it with a transfer case.
rear_final_drive.unknown_values: Required; no inferred hardware ratio or disconnect setting is a verified default.

inputs: selected solid or surface CAD bodies
native solid mass, or surface thickness plus SolidWorks material density, or excluded surface mass
panel.generation: Infer a plane from the CAD extent, sample the projected surface, preserve openings, use surface triangles for collision and numerical depth locators for stability.
panel.limits: Curved panels use bulk until a surface-following panel implementation is qualified. Panel bending and rupture are not calibrated. An entirely weightless selection follows a physical parent with no independent collision or breakaway.

bulk.generation: Use alpha wrap with bounded density trials; convex is an explicit alternative. Fit CAD mass and moments using a sparse internal structure.
bulk.limits: Engine internals and damage are not represented by an enclosing bulk cage.

wishbone.generation: One main axial member per leg, an inboard cross member, and sparse volumetric bracing. All nodes and skin belong to one arm component; chassis bushings and upright ball joint are separate connections.
checks: six free rigid-body modes for the arm
wishbone.limits: A single beam carries axial load only. It cannot by itself make a rigid wishbone or define a hinge.

trailing_arm.generation: One structural arm component with a volumetric rigid cage. Two separated pivot points define the chassis hinge; the hub and spring/damper mounts follow that arm. Add toe or camber links only when present in the real assembly.
checks: single intended pivot degree of freedom

rear_final_drive_with_front_output.generation: Implement the declared CVT/rear-final-drive/front-geared-output power graph after hardware parameters are provided. Reuse a stock device only if its ports and torque/speed behavior match this contract.
checks: compiled device graph matches the declared route
rear_final_drive_with_front_output.recorder_contract: Extend the exported_vehicle manifest and recorder capabilities for CVT and rear geared output. Do not invent mainEngine/clutch/gearbox/transfercase/frontShaft devices to satisfy the old synthetic-vehicle tests.

implementation_order.evidence: Offline regression tests, isolated native CAD fixtures, and owned BeamNG mounting scenarios.

deliverables: include dedicated parent mount nodes before frame mass/stiffness fitting
invalidate calibration after moving mount nodes
implementation_order.evidence: Fresh calibration and mount tests for each changed graph; current immutable-frame fallback uses a spanning support patch and reports its size.
Analytical mobility and travel sweep, then pinned-chassis BeamNG articulation, then complete rolling chassis.
Ratio/direction/conservation tests, supported drivetrain, acceleration/braking/reverse, then steering and articulation under power.

deliverables: real CAD ownership and hardpoint review
implementation_order.evidence: Three independent recordings per scenario with current file hashes and rendered evidence; retain generation, recording and qualification as separate statuses.

iteration: run owned BeamNG scenarios in one reusable session
archive compact passing evidence and full failure evidence
continuous_work.ownership: Do not save/restart the user's SolidWorks session or alter normal installed mods during automatic verification.
